recommend.goal: Prepare the recommendation for a kind of work no catalog task type names. First read what is already known (read_known). Choose, from the closed list, the catalog task type the work would run and be measured as, or none_fits only when the work needs something no listed type does (choose_type). Only when known data names no verified environment tagged for the domain, look at public sources (fetch_source) and record what is worth showing as an unverified lead (record_candidate). Then finish_recommendation. You never rank and never choose the default: code asks the owner.

done.reason: the recommendation is ready and the owner is asked one question; nothing was installed or run

none_fits.reason: no catalog task type fits this work, so nothing can be recommended to run; the leads, if any, are shown to the owner
